countBoundary: Retained file occurrences/bytes across overlapping records, not unique tests or distinct scientific subjects. Complete safe extraction and exact tree reassembly precede actual public reads.

publicReadbackOutcomes.policy: All original/extracted nonzero outcomes preserved. Same-byte duplicate subject aliases identify one exact-reader receipt, not extra reruns. Qualification statuses stay raw and accepted:false.

priorGeneration.policy: Unchanged prior121 archives/current+initial maps/190669-byte report referenced rather than re-archived or rewritten. Actual historical readers/results remain bound to their old subjects.

independentArchiveAudit.scope: ONE independent audit of new frozen archives only; prior121 unchanged, not re-audited. Integrity proof, not qualification. Root metadata frozen after07:15:45.744UTC; no recursive archive/audit.

retentionGaps.scope: Task-owned isolated default directory inspected read-only after journey failure while normal R1 continued its internal next suite; deletion instant not observed. No old active defaults touched by this inspection.

failureAttachmentSurvival.disposition: Absent at first inspection; original screenshot/DOM bytes cannot be claimed retained or reconstructed. Raw failed Playwright result still retained.
failureAttachmentSurvival.pathResolution: Known owned Lab root plus exact recorded relative suffix; recorded reference retained verbatim separately from resolved host path.

retentionGaps.boundary: Do not infer all attachment references survived from a later default-directory copy. Preserve failed JSON/log and surviving pre-Run screens; no rerun/fake image/status replacement.
retentionGaps.ownerLimitation: Owner scheduled isolated default preservation after the whole recorder and did not capture these two first-spec failure files before internal default reuse. Their bytes/hash cannot be claimed preserved. Deletion instant was not observed; no fake reconstruction or rerun.

privacy.policy: All indexed public members verified does not mean all private raw host/runtime context is public. Exact exclusions/marked derivatives retain original inventory/receipt hash attribution.

limitations: No new engineering review, installed Linux/native trust, physical/calibration/human acceptance, remote availability, HTTPS/container qualification, deployment or D0 launch is implied.
